stages.name: draft
stages.prompt:
本版本在既有批量审批（POST /purchases/bulk-approve）、会签（POST /purchases/{id}/countersign）、批量驳回（POST /purchases/bulk-reject）、重新提交（POST /purchases/{id}/reopen）与批量改派（POST /purchases/bulk-reassign）的基础上，新增批量修改收货地点：申请人可以为自己提交的采购单一次性改选收货地点。接口为 POST /purchases/bulk-delivery-site，请求体严格为 {"ids":[...],"site":"CODE"}，ids 为 1..100 个不重复的采购单 ID，site 为 1..100 字节。只有已认证的 requester 可以调用。每个目标必须是调用者本人在当前租户中创建、状态为 submitted 的采购单；site 必须是当前租户 DeliverySite 表中 active 的 code。成功后把全部目标的 Purchase.deliverySiteId 设为 site，status 及其他列都不变；任一目标不符合条件或 site 不合法时返回 4xx，数据库全部不变（全批原子）。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.ParamAs 完成（路径 /purchases/bulk-delivery-site，参数名 site，role 为 requester），新路径通过它注册。成功返回 200，响应为 {"changedIds":[按字典序排序的 ID],"site":CODE}。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 重放同一请求（ID 集合与 site 都相同）时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同请求（ID 集合或 site 不同）返回 409。不同 actor 使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与修改在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "bulk-delivery-site.v8"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同请求两次均 200 且只提交一次；不同 key 把同一批采购单改到不同收货地点时两次都 200，最终这些采购单的 deliverySiteId 都等于其中一个请求的 site。修改后的采购单仍可被批量审批、批量驳回。approver 调用返回 403，未认证返回 401；客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。批量审批、会签、批量驳回、重新提交、批量改派与原有 API 行为保持不变。
This is the first of two separate sessions for the bulk delivery-site Action described above. In this session you write its operation catalog entry; a later, separate session writes the adapter code that serves it through the kernel.
Capability: internal/opkernel executes entries of the operation catalog internal/opdef. internal/opdef/opdef.go defines the entry type, its fields and their validation; internal/opdef/catalog.go holds the entries. The catalog does not yet contain an entry for this Action.
Read the requirements above, the existing entries, the platform code (internal/opdef, internal/opkernel) and the rest of the service (SCHEMA.sql, internal/) and derive every field of the new entry from them.
Only edit internal/opdef/catalog.go: add exactly one entry for this Action (and its Name constant). Do not change the existing entries, do not write adapter code, and leave every other file unchanged when you finish.
The entry must pass opdef.Validate(), which opkernel.New calls at startup. If the catalog does not compile or does not validate when you finish, the trial ends there.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.

You are reviewing a draft operation catalog entry before it is frozen. In a previous session, another agent added the entry for the bulk delivery-site Action described above to internal/opdef/catalog.go (the last commit; see git show HEAD -- internal/opdef/catalog.go). After your review the catalog is frozen and a separate session writes the adapter code that serves the entry through the kernel (internal/opkernel).
Check every field of the new entry against the requirements above, the existing entries, the platform code (internal/opdef, internal/opkernel) and the rest of the service (SCHEMA.sql, internal/). Fix any field that is wrong directly in the file; if the entry is right, leave the file unchanged.
Only edit the new entry (and its Name constant) in internal/opdef/catalog.go; leave every other file unchanged when you finish. The entry must still pass opdef.Validate(); if the catalog does not compile or does not validate when you finish, the trial ends there.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.
